As a doctor, you can see no signs of swelling, and it's confirmed not to be a respiratory infection. What are the possible causes from the data you can gather?

message.content: With no visible swelling and respiratory infection ruled out, possible causes include muscular tension from poor posture or overuse, anxiety-related throat tightness, mild pharyngitis or postnasal drip, acid reflux, salivary gland swelling, small lymph node enlargement, or early dental/throat inflammation. Stiff neck may suggest cervical strain. I recommend monitoring for fever, swallowing difficulty, drooling, or worsening pain. If symptoms persist, a clinician may examine the neck, review vitals, and consider ultrasound or lab testing to identify the exact cause.
